name: Bouncing Baboon
summary:
Bouncing Baboon is a explorable game where you can bounce and swing your way through the game, there are a variety of maps you can play through, such as:

Forest - Jump around on trampolines or climb up trees for a ton of fun

Caves - Go down the slippery slide into the echoing cave where you will be tasked with mining resources (in a future update)

Shop - take a break from the chaos and put on some wear for your baboon
